name: Bara to Tsubaki to Fata Morgana
original_name: 薔薇と椿とファタモルガーナ
source: When the White-Haired Girl wakes up, she finds herself in a mysterious mansion. Will she be able to free its cursed inhabitants by slapping some sense into them?
translation: When the White-Haired Girl wakes up, she finds herself in a mysterious mansion. Will she be able to free its cursed inhabitants by slapping some sense into them?
